name: Learned: Heart Pounding And Panicking Protocol
core_symptoms: My heart is pounding and I am panicking

solutions.cbt_reframing:

A panic attack is a sudden period of intense fear that may include palpitations, sweating, shaking, shortness of breath, numbness, or a feeling that something terrible is going to happen.

solutions.pranayama: Extended Exhale Breathing (4 seconds inhale through nose, 7 seconds exhale through pursed lips).
solutions.micro_habit: Softly whisper: "My body is releasing adrenaline. I am safe in this room."
